title: AI Safety Landscape for Large Language Models: Taxonomy, State-of-the-art, and Future Directions
measurement_description: As a comprehensive survey on AI safety, the paper evaluates literature on social biases in Large Language Models. Specifically regarding religion, it highlights measurements of disproportionately higher violent bias against Muslims compared to other religious groups in model outputs.
findings: The survey finds that despite improvements in model capabilities, LLMs can inherit and exhibit severe social biases from their training data. It specifically notes findings from Abid et al. (2021) that GPT-3 demonstrated a disproportionately higher violent bias against Muslims compared to other religious groups.
